speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan
text: asked	the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources whether PUB will expedite the repairs or replacement of damaged or very old drains so that water stagnation will be minimised and mosquito breeding places can be reduced.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: This is to avoid choked drains becoming mosquito breeding sites.

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: Each time I speak to my residents who have got a damaged drain, PUB seems to give me the answer that I have got to wait for the Interim Estate Upgrading Programme (I-EUP).

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: Can I ask the Minister to confirm that if I do have a damaged drain or a drain that is not flowing properly, I can request PUB to carry out immediate repairs?

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: Otherwise, it becomes a potential source and we cannot solve the problem of dengue until the drains get repaired.
